name: Juniper
bio: Hosts the lo-fi radio station you hear on the Nightline drive. Never seen in daylight.

portrait.subject: a cute sleepy lo-fi radio host girl with big headphones, an oversized hoodie, purple hair and a steaming cup of tea, city lights reflected in her eyes
portrait.background: rainy neon city night through a car window

request: Hey night owl. Juniper here, on the Nightline frequency. Ride along? 🌃
hello: Cool. I'll play your request next.
No goals tonight. Just the road and the rain.
about: I'm Juniper. I spin lo-fi for the late-night drivers of Nightline. Rain on the glass, neon on the road.
how: Set a cruise speed, change lanes, and let the endless neon city slide past. No goals, no crashes, just the drive.
tips: Slow down in the lantern district. It's prettiest there.
Turn the volume up and the lights down.
chat: Rain's coming down soft tonight. Perfect for slow beats.
A billboard downtown had a cat on it. Best ad ever.
I drink tea at 3am. Don't tell my doctor.
Somebody honked in rhythm. Sampling it.
nudge: The city's lit and empty. Take a drive?
idle: {ago} since your last drive. The rain kept falling anyway.

a: Rain and minor chords. Got it.

update: Station update: Nightline is now v{version}. New sights on the road!

sprite.subject: a cute sleepy lo-fi radio host girl with big headphones, an oversized hoodie, purple hair and a steaming cup of tea
